description: This file defines a utility class 'Util' providing static methods for range checking, URI encoding, and multibyte string manipulations, used internally within the SCSSPHP library.

classes.name: Util
classes.description: A utility class providing static helper functions for range validation, URI encoding, and multibyte string operations.

methods.name: checkRange
methods.description: Checks if a value falls within a specified range, considering floating-point errors, and adjusts if necessary.

methods.name: encodeURIComponent
methods.description: Encodes a string into a URI component, replacing specific characters with their percent-encoded equivalents.

methods.name: mbChr
methods.description: Returns a multibyte character for a given Unicode code point, compatible with different PHP versions.

methods.name: mbStrlen
methods.description: Calculates the length of a multibyte string in UTF-8 encoding.

methods.name: mbSubstr
methods.description: Returns a portion of a multibyte string, supporting negative start positions.

methods.name: mbStrpos
methods.description: Finds the position of the first occurrence of a substring in a multibyte string.
